title: One-off Mapping Configuration
description: Schema for one-off import mapping files — ad-hoc column mappings for a single import session.

version.description: Schema version of this mapping configuration.

type.description: Entity type key that this import targets (e.g. 'contexts', 'finds').

description.description: Human-readable description of this import session.

format.description: Source data format for this import.

column.description: Column mappings: source column name → target field configuration.

target.description: Target entity field. Known values: 'source_id', 'name', 'entity_type', 'geometry:lat', 'geometry:lng', 'geometry:wkt', 'classification', 'date:from', 'date:to', 'date:type', or any string for a custom entity property key.

relation.description: Relation extraction rules: rule name → relation config.

source_column.description: Source column containing target entity source_ids.

delimiter.description: Separator for multiple target source_ids in a single cell.
